Railway RRB Paramedical CEN 05/2026 Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the notification for the post of Paramedical Staff Posts on the official website of RRB. This recruitment has released for 590 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2026 has Started from 15 September 2026, & candidate can apply until 14 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 14 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 October 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 17-26 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
